key_findings: Embryonic Nav1.7 null sensory neurons upregulate Nav1.1, Nav1.2 and beta4 protein (without transcript change), potentially compensating for lost excitability
Low intracellular sodium potentiates opioid inhibition of Nav1.8 currents, supporting a sodium-regulated opioid mechanism for Nav1.7 null analgesia
